prompt: Stocky xianxia ward mason, chibi with a very large head and short body, small human in a light warm cream stone-dust tunic with sand-coloured rolled sleeves, a rust-brown leather apron over the front, a soft pale cloth cap, short tan beard, thick forearms. A bronze stone chisel with a warm-brown wooden handle is pushed through his belt at his RIGHT hip, the bright bronze blade angled outward and down, clearly visible against the pale tunic (asymmetric: nothing on the left hip). Front-facing 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.

idle.action_description: stands still and breathes gently, chest and shoulders rising slightly and falling; the bronze chisel stays pushed through the belt at the same right hip, clearly visible

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, breathes gently; the bronze chisel stays pushed through his belt at his right hip on the viewer's left, bright blade always visible
direction_prompts.west: facing left, breathes gently; the bronze chisel stays in his belt at the hip, bright blade always visible
direction_prompts.north: back to the viewer, breathes gently; the bronze chisel stays in his belt at his right hip on the viewer's right, bright blade always visible
direction_prompts.east: facing right, breathes gently; the bronze chisel stays in his belt at the hip, bright blade always visible

interact.action_description: taps the bronze chisel at his hip with one hand as if checking it, then lets go; the chisel always stays in the belt at the same hip and clearly visible

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, his right hand (the viewer's left) goes to the bronze chisel in his belt at that hip, pats it, then lets go; the chisel never moves to the other hip
direction_prompts.west: facing left, his near hand goes to the bronze chisel in his belt at the hip, pats it, then lets go; the chisel stays in the belt
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, his right hand (the viewer's right) goes to the bronze chisel in his belt at that hip, pats it, then lets go; the chisel stays in the belt on the viewer's right
direction_prompts.east: facing right, his near hand goes to the bronze chisel in his belt at the hip, pats it, then lets go; the chisel stays in the belt
